description: This file implements a buffer utility module providing functions for buffer initialization, freeing, moving, resizing, string manipulation, encoding/decoding, and path operations. It is part of a larger C project related to HTTP or web server functionalities, as indicated by functions for URL encoding and path handling.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ buffer * buffer_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes a new buffer structure with allocated memory.

methods.name: void buffer_free(buffer * b)
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a buffer.

methods.name: void buffer_free_ptr(buffer * b)
methods.description: Frees buffer content but keeps structure intact, resetting its pointers and sizes.

methods.name: void buffer_move(buffer * restrict b,buffer * restrict src)
methods.description: Swaps content between two buffers.

methods.name: buffer_realloc
methods.description: Reallocates the buffer's internal storage to accommodate at least 'len'.

methods.name: buffer_alloc_replace
methods.description: Replaces the buffer's storage entirely and discards old data.

methods.name: char * buffer_string_prepare_copy(buffer * const b,const size_t size)
methods.description: Prepares the buffer for copying string data of a specific size.

methods.name: char * buffer_string_prepare_append(buffer * const b,const size_t size)
methods.description: Prepares the buffer to append a string of a specified size.

methods.name: buffer_string_prepare_append_resize
methods.description: Resizes buffer to accommodate appending data.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ char * buffer_extend(buffer * const b,const size_t x)
methods.description: Extends buffer to accommodate additional data of a given size.

methods.name: void buffer_commit(buffer * b,size_t size)
methods.description: Commits a size of data to the buffer, updating its used length.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void buffer_copy_string(buffer * restrict b,const char * restrict s)
methods.description: Copies a null-terminated string to the buffer.

methods.name: void buffer_copy_string_len(buffer * const restrict b,const char * const restrict s,const size_t len)
methods.description: Copies a string with a specified length to the buffer.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void buffer_append_string(buffer * restrict b,const char * restrict s)
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated string to the buffer.

methods.name: void buffer_append_string_len(buffer * const restrict b,const char * const restrict s,const size_t len)
methods.description: Appends a string with specified length to the buffer.

methods.name: void buffer_append_str2(buffer * const restrict b,const char * const s1,const size_t len1,const char * const s2,const size_t len2)
methods.description: Appends two strings with lengths to the buffer.

methods.name: void buffer_append_str3(buffer * const restrict b,const char * const s1,const size_t len1,const char * const s2,const size_t len2,const char * const s3,const size_t len3)
methods.description: Appends three strings with lengths to the buffer.

methods.name: void buffer_append_iovec(buffer * const restrict b,const struct const_iovec * const iov,const size_t n)
methods.description: Appends multiple iovec buffers to the buffer.

methods.name: void buffer_append_path_len(buffer * restrict b,const char * restrict a,size_t alen)
methods.description: Appends a path segment of specified length, handling slashes correctly.

methods.name: void buffer_copy_path_len2(buffer * const restrict b,const char * const restrict s1,size_t len1,const char * const restrict s2,size_t len2)
methods.description: Copies two path segments into buffer, combining them.

methods.name: void buffer_copy_string_len_lc(buffer * const restrict b,const char * const restrict s,const size_t len)
methods.description: Copies a string with lowercased characters into the buffer.

methods.name: void buffer_append_uint_hex_lc(buffer * b,uintmax_t value)
methods.description: Appends an unsigned integer as lowercase hex string.

methods.name: void buffer_append_int(buffer * b,intmax_t val)
methods.description: Appends an integer as string.

methods.name: void buffer_append_strftime(buffer * const restrict b,const char * const restrict format,const struct tm * const restrict tm)
methods.description: Appends formatted date/time string based on a format and tm struct.

methods.name: size_t li_itostrn(char * buf,size_t buf_len,intmax_t val)
methods.description: Converts an intmax_t to string, up to buffer length.

methods.name: size_t li_utostrn(char * buf,size_t buf_len,uintmax_t val)
methods.description: Converts a uintmax_t to string, up to buffer length.

methods.name: char hex2int(unsigned char hex)
methods.description: Converts a hex character to its integer value.

methods.name: int li_hex2bin(unsigned char * const bin,const size_t binlen,const char * const hexstr,const size_t len)
methods.description: Converts a hex string to binary data.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ int buffer_eq_icase_ssn(const char * const a,const char * const b,const size_t len)
methods.description: Case-insensitive string comparison for a fixed length.

methods.name: int buffer_eq_icase_ss(const char * const a,const size_t alen,const char * const b,const size_t blen)
methods.description: Case-insensitive string comparison with string lengths.

methods.name: int buffer_eq_icase_slen(const buffer * const b,const char * const s,const size_t slen)
methods.description: Case-insensitive comparison of buffer and string with length.

methods.name: int buffer_eq_slen(const buffer * const b,const char * const s,const size_t slen)
methods.description: Comparison of two buffers with length.

methods.name: int buffer_is_equal(const buffer * a,const buffer * b)
methods.description: Checks if two buffers contain identical data.

methods.name: void buffer_append_string_encoded(buffer * const restrict b,const char * const restrict s,size_t len,buffer_encoding_t encoding)
methods.description: Encodes and appends a string in a specified encoding (URL, HTML, XML).

methods.name: void buffer_append_string_c_escaped(buffer * const restrict b,const char * const restrict s,size_t len)
methods.description: Escapes a string for C string literals and appends.

methods.name: void buffer_append_string_encoded_hex_lc(buffer * const restrict b,const char * const restrict s,size_t len)
methods.description: Encodes a string as lowercase hex and appends.

methods.name: void buffer_append_string_encoded_hex_uc(buffer * const restrict b,const char * const restrict s,size_t len)
methods.description: Encodes a string as uppercase hex and appends.

methods.name: void buffer_urldecode_path(buffer * const b)
methods.description: Decodes URL-encoded characters within a buffer.

methods.name: int buffer_is_valid_UTF8(const buffer * b)
methods.description: Checks if the buffer contains valid UTF-8 data.

methods.name: void buffer_path_simplify(buffer * b)
methods.description: Simplifies a filesystem path resolving '.', '..', and redundant slashes.

methods.name: void buffer_to_lower(buffer * const b)
methods.description: Converts buffer contents to lowercase.

methods.name: void buffer_to_upper(buffer * const b)
methods.description: Converts buffer contents to uppercase.
